title: Page 9
content_zh:
于是她就把这当成是自己的工作，她要努力多写，她希望可以让……可以让廷汉安心的走。
但也因此，她每晚边抄写经文边不停的哭泣，但是她不停，努力的写着。
现在，她只希望廷汉在往后可以不用再受苦，可以安息，可以安安静静的追求来生……
来生，他可以不要再做流氓，可以做他想做的任何事情……
不知怎的，今晚她或许特别累，边抄边哭，让她的力气迅速耗尽，写满了四、五张纸后，她就趴在桌上睡着了。
就在此时，后头的门
“看来她睡着了。”
“我终于找到她了……”这个男的就赵廷汉！
经过了两个月不眠不休的寻找，他不只亲自寻人，甚至动用了各地警力，终于在这个深山里找到了这个女人——这个几乎要让他发狂的女人。
天知道，他一得知明慧失踪时，几乎发疯……
刚结束卧底、脱离“刘伟强”这个身分的那几天，他一直躲着不能出面，想暂避锋头，哪里也不能去；而那几天他也忙着整理证据，帮傲辰的忙，希望能顺利起诉刘兆。
因此他完全不知道明慧在音乐会上当场昏倒的事，当然更不知道明慧被送往医院的当晚就离开了医院，从此不知去向。
“两个多月前，我下山处理事情，在山路上看到她；她就坐在路旁，看起来……精神不太好，她说她走了很远的路，完全不知道自己身在何处，结果竟然走到这附近来。”比丘尼对着赵廷汉解释，沈明慧为什么会出现在这里。
赵廷汉眼睛看着那个趴在桌上睡着的女人，耳朵专心听着。
“我看她好像很绝望的样子，很担心她会寻短，所以就把她带回精舍，这段时间，她都住在这里。”比丘尼看了这个年轻男人一眼，“她跟我说，她喜欢的那个男生死了，她也活不下去……所以我让她在这里每天都做很多事，希望她可以忙到忘记要寻短。”
第10章(2)
他听得很痛苦，没想到自己的假死竟让明慧这么伤心。事实上，死的是刘伟强，不是赵廷汉……
“你……就是明慧说的那个阿汉吧？”
苦笑，“是我。”
笑着点点头，“我就在想，明慧不像是个命苦的女孩，这种事情不应该发生在她的身上。”

“是我的错……”
比丘尼笑了笑，开口却是道歉，“我要说声抱歉，为了让明慧不胡思乱想，为了让她有事做，可以分散注意力，我骗她说，抄写佛经可以超渡亡魂，抄愈多愈好。所以这两个多月来，她每天晚上都在这里，整晚都不睡觉，一直抄写佛经，没有间断的抄写。”
赵廷汉听了，全身震动，那种感觉无以言表，那种感动无以复加。明慧竟然为了他，做这么多。
“好几次我要她早点去睡，她却说她要多抄几遍，她希望……可以让阿汉安息，下辈子可以投胎到好人家，她想为阿汉多做一点事，她说这是她现在唯一能为阿汉做的事情了。”
赵廷汉红了眼眶，握紧拳头。他死了，她竟然还在为他着想，他真的对不起她，他到底为她做过什么？
重逢以来，他让她失望、让她伤心、让她哭泣，现在又让她为了他，整夜不眠，只希望死去的他能安息。
这辈子，他真的对不起这个女人。“谢谢你，谢谢你这么照顾明慧。”
“看来是有点误会啊！赶快把明慧带回家吧！”那位比丘尼退了下去，将空间留给这对年轻男女。
赵廷汉脱下鞋子，走进屋内，轻声来到书桌旁。
明慧趴在桌上睡着，眉头紧皱，似乎睡得很不安稳，脸颊的泪水未干，显见刚刚才哭过。
来到她身旁，这两个月来他生不如死，每天都在寻找，就怕她想不开，他会终生遗憾；现在，终于来到她身旁了。
可是他竟然有点胆怯，这女人的爱怎么会这么深、这么强，他怕……他无以回报……
除了拿出自己所有的爱，他别无回报之法。“明慧，明慧！”
沈明慧一惊醒，拍拍脸颊，“我怎么睡着了？不行……赶快写……”
她拿起笔，在纸上继续振笔疾书，完全没注意到身旁的人——她将自己关在自己的情绪中，脑海只想着那个人，然后希望将所有的福报都传给他，希望他从此无忧。
“明慧。”
她一停笔，动也不敢动，只能慢慢转过头——她看到了，是他，是廷汉……真的是他……
她的眼眶瞬间一湿，不能言语。
赵廷汉蹲下身子，眼神与她齐高，直接握住她握笔的手，让她感受自己的温暖。
她没有感觉到那双手的温暖，只是喃喃念着，任由泪水滑落，“你来了……我还以为你都不会来……”

赵廷汉知道她一定是把他当鬼了，他想笑，可却流出泪水，摇摇头，将她抱进他怀里。
沈明慧没察觉，只是靠在他宽阔的怀里，不断哭泣。“我以为你都不会来……我晚上作梦的时候，你都没有出现，你为什么不来？我每天晚上都在哭……”
“我这不就来了吗？”
她紧紧抱住他，像个孩子一样放声大哭，“阿汉……我好舍不得你……真的，我好舍不得你……”
他含着泪水，苦笑摇头——是他自找苦吃，现在该怎么解释，她才可能相信？该怎么说，她才相信他还活着？
“我也抄好多经文，统统是给你的……”她拉开桌子的抽屉，将里面那一大叠一大叠纸统统拿出来，然后塞进赵廷汉手里。“师父说，这样可以超渡亡魂，我会继续抄，阿汉……阿汉……”
赵廷汉看着自己手里那一大叠纸，上头写满了字，每一张似乎都有水渍，那应该是她泪水的痕迹。“这我到底该怎么用？”
“我也不知道……”
“傻瓜！”声音一扬，“我没死！只有你这个傻女人，什么都没弄清楚就跑了，然后一个人做这么多，笨蛋啊……”
“阿汉……”
抓住她的手，放在自己胸口，“我没死！感觉到了吗？”
沈明慧看着他，脸上满是不可思议，同时也慢慢出现了光彩，喜悦终于出现在她的脸上。
赵廷汉紧紧抱住她，叹息，也流泪。
这女人太好也太傻，好到让他舍不得放手，傻到让他心疼……
傻女人……
夜深了，山里的夜晚什么声音都有，蝉鸣、鸟叫，甚至空谷回音，只要静下心来都可以听得见。
赵廷汉背着沈明慧离开了精舍，来到了一旁的一座小凉亭里。他背着她，她则紧紧抱住他，死也不放。
失而复得，真是太难得了，她很激动，当然也怕是一场梦！所以紧紧抱住他，就怕下一秒钟他会消失，然后梦会醒过来；如果真是这样，她只能再度大哭一场。
赵廷汉知道她的心情，就让她抱住自己，缠绕自己颈部的手紧到让他有点痛，但还是让她抱。
如果可以安抚她，还是让她抱……

来到凉亭，他坐在石椅上；沈明慧虽然放手，但立刻换到前头，在他胸前抱住他，头靠在他的胸前，听着那心跳，想再次确定，这是真的，他没死，他还活着！
赵廷汉摸摸她的头发，“不用听了，我还活着。”
“你骗我！你知道我哭得有多惨吗？”她含着泪水抱怨着。
“对不起。”
继续靠在他胸前，她嘟着嘴问：“我看新闻，上面说你真的……死了啊……”她就是因为受到这个打击，才会在音乐会上当场昏倒的。
content_en:
So she regarded this as her job. She had to work hard to write more. She hoped that... she could let Tinghan leave in peace.
But because of this, she kept crying while copying scriptures every night, but she kept writing hard.
Now, she only hopes that Tinghan will no longer have to suffer in the future, can rest in peace, and can quietly pursue the next life...
In the next life, he can stop being a gangster and do whatever he wants...
Somehow, she might be particularly tired tonight. She cried while copying, which quickly depleted her strength. After filling four or five pieces of paper, she fell asleep on the table.
At this moment, the door at the back
"Looks like she fell asleep."
"I finally found her..." This man is Zhao Tinghan!
After two months of sleepless searching, he not only personally searched for the person, but even mobilized police forces from all over the country to finally find this woman in the deep mountains - this woman who almost drove him crazy.
God knows, when he learned that Minghui was missing, he almost went crazy...
In the days after he finished undercover and got out of the identity of "Liu Weiqiang", he had been hiding and unable to come forward. He wanted to avoid the limelight for a while and could not go anywhere. In those days, he was also busy organizing evidence to help Ao Chen, hoping to successfully prosecute Liu Zhao.
Therefore, he had no idea that Minghui fainted on the spot at the concert. Of course, he did not know that Minghui left the hospital that night and disappeared since then.
"More than two months ago, I went down the mountain to deal with some matters and saw her on the mountain road; she was sitting by the roadside, looking... not in good spirits. She said that she had walked a long way and had no idea where she was, and ended up here." The nun explained to Zhao Tinghan why Shen Minghui appeared here.
Zhao Tinghan looked at the woman sleeping on the table and listened intently.
"I saw that she seemed desperate and worried that she would find fault, so I took her back to the monastery. During this period, she lived here." The bhikshuni glanced at the young man. "She told me that the boy she liked died and she couldn't survive... So I asked her to do a lot of things here every day, hoping that she would be busy enough to forget to find fault."
Chapter 10(2)
He heard it in pain, but he didn't expect that his fake death would make Minghui so sad. In fact, it was Liu Weiqiang who died, not Zhao Tinghan...
"You...are the Ahan Minghui mentioned, right?"
Smiling bitterly, "It's me."
Smiling and nodding, "I was just thinking that Minghui doesn't look like a girl with a hard life. This kind of thing shouldn't happen to her."
"It's my fault..."
The bhikshuni smiled and apologized, "I want to apologize. In order to keep Minghui from thinking wildly and to give her something to do to distract her attention, I lied to her and said that copying Buddhist scriptures can transcend the souls of the dead. The more you copy, the better. So for more than two months, she has been here every night, staying up all night, and copying Buddhist scriptures without interruption."
After Zhao Tinghan heard this, his whole body was shaken. The feeling was beyond words, and the feeling was beyond words. Minghui actually did so much for him.
"I asked her to go to bed early several times, but she said she wanted to copy it a few more times. She hoped... to let Ahan rest in peace and be reborn in a good family in the next life. She wanted to do more for Ahan. She said this was the only thing she could do for Ahan now."
Zhao Tinghan's eyes were red and he clenched his fists. He was dead, but she was still thinking about him. He was really sorry for her. What on earth had he done for her?
Since their reunion, he had let her down, made her sad, made her cry, and now he made her stay up all night because of him, just hoping that he could rest in peace after his death.
In this life, he is really sorry for this woman. "Thank you, thank you for taking such good care of Minghui."
"It seems there is a misunderstanding! Take Minghui home quickly!" The bhikshuni retreatedHe stepped down, leaving space for the young man and woman.
Zhao Tinghan took off his shoes, walked into the house, and came to the desk softly.
Minghui fell asleep lying on the table, her brows furrowed, as if she had slept uneasily, and the tears on her cheeks were not dry, showing that she had just cried.
Coming to her side, he had been searching for her every day for the past two months, just because he was afraid that she would not be able to think about it and he would regret it for the rest of his life; now, he finally came to her side.
But he was a little timid. How could this woman's love be so deep and strong? He was afraid...he wouldn't be able to repay...
He has no other way to repay him than to give him all his love. "Minghui, Minghui!"
Shen Minghui woke up with a start and patted her cheek, "Why did I fall asleep? No...write quickly..."
She picked up the pen and continued to write rapidly on the paper, completely unaware of the person beside her - she locked herself in her own emotions, thinking only of that person, and then hoped to pass on all the blessings to him, hoping that he would be free from worries.
"Minghui."
As soon as she stopped writing, she didn't dare to move. She could only turn her head slowly - she saw it, it was him, it was Tinghan... it was really him...
Her eyes instantly became wet and she could not speak.
Zhao Tinghan squatted down, his eyes level with hers, and directly held her hand holding the pen, letting her feel his warmth.
She didn't feel the warmth of those hands, she just muttered and let her tears fall, "You're here... I thought you wouldn't even come..."
Zhao Tinghan knew that she must have thought him a ghost. He wanted to laugh, but instead shed tears, shook his head, and hugged her into his arms.
Shen Minghui didn't notice, she just leaned into his broad arms and kept crying. "I thought you wouldn't come... When I dreamed at night, you didn't show up. Why didn't you come? I cry every night..."
"Aren't I coming right now?"
She hugged him tightly and cried loudly like a child, "Ahan... I really can't let you go... Really, I really can't let you go..."
With tears in his eyes, he shook his head with a wry smile - he was asking for trouble, how should he explain it now so that she could believe it? What should she say to make her believe that he was still alive?
"I also copied a lot of scriptures, all for you..." She opened the drawer of the desk, took out all the large stacks of papers inside, and then stuffed them into Zhao Tinghan's hands. "Master said that this can transcend the souls of the dead. I will continue to copy, Ahan...Ahan..."
Zhao Tinghan looked at the large pile of paper in his hand, which was full of words. Every piece seemed to have water stains, which should be traces of her tears. "How on earth should I use this?"
"I don't know either..."
"Fool!" the voice shouted, "I'm not dead! It's just you, a stupid woman, who ran away without understanding anything, and then did so much by yourself, you idiot..."
"Ahan..."
He grabbed her hand and put it on his chest, "I'm not dead! Do you feel it?"
Shen Minghui looked at him, her face full of disbelief, and at the same time, a light slowly appeared on her face, and joy finally appeared on her face.
Zhao Tinghan hugged her tightly, sighed and shed tears.
This woman was too good and too stupid, so good that he couldn't bear to let her go, so stupid that it made him feel bad...
Stupid woman...
It's late at night, and there are all kinds of sounds in the mountains at night, including the chirping of cicadas, the chirping of birds, and even the echo of the empty valley. You can hear it as long as you calm down.
Zhao Tinghan left the monastery with Shen Minghui on his back and came to a small pavilion nearby. He carried her on his back, and she hugged him tightly and wouldn't let go.
It was so rare to find something lost again. She was very excited, but of course she was also afraid that it was just a dream! So she hugged him tightly, fearing that he would disappear in the next second and wake up from the dream; if this was the case, she could only cry again.
Zhao Tinghan knew her mood, so he let her hug him. The hand wrapped around his neck was so tight that it hurt him, but he still let her hug him.
If you can comfort her, let her hold her...
comeHe was sitting on a stone chair in the pavilion; although Shen Minghui let go, she immediately moved to the front, hugged him in front of his chest, and leaned her head on his chest, listening to the heartbeat, wanting to confirm again that this was true, he was not dead, he was still alive!
Zhao Tinghan touched her hair and said, "Don't listen, I'm still alive."
"You lied to me! Do you know how hard I cried?" She complained with tears in her eyes.
"I'm sorry."
Continuing to lean against his chest, she pouted and asked, "I read the news and it said you are really... dead..." It was because of this blow that she fainted on the spot at the concert.
